name: nms-initial-load-sample
origin: delivered by the FAA with API registration, as nmsapi_sample_initial_load.xml
delivery: email attachment, not an HTTP capture
captured_by: not python -m aeropub.capture; this file arrived out of band and is stored verbatim
note: Real FAA-issued sample content, stored byte for byte and unedited. It carries two genuine NOTAM (8WC runway end identifier lights, and a ZBW UAS airspace notice) and no credential of any kind. The numberReturned attribute reports 21468 because the sample is an excerpt of a full domestic load; tests assert against the two messages actually present and treat the mismatch as the truncation signal it is.
